axes.name: pointer_storage
axes.rationale: Target loop loads the Dx8 segment-8 selector once, reads ES:[SI], increments SI by two, and tests SI against 0x8e5c. A typed far int pointer initialized at Dx8+0x8e54 models the same addressed words and pointer lifetime; compare ordinary and register storage only.

semantic_summary: Isolated typed far-pointer representation of the target Dx8 word scan; compare ordinary and register local pointer declarations without changing source semantics, calls, or surrounding function logic.
binding_evidence: Factory packet directly binds the read at target offset 37520 to _Dx8, SEG8 selector slot 49284, addressed segment 8, displacement zero, index SI. Target initializes SI to 0x8e54, adds 2, and stops at 0x8e5c. These are four 16-bit words, equivalent to a far int pointer over Dx8[0x8e54..0x8e5c).
